title: Not for anyone who has neck issues
text: Not for anyone who has neck issues. It wasn't bad at first. However, the next day after trying it out, I had a horrible headache and neck pain.

product_metadata.title: Sealy DuoChill Cooling Memory Foam Pillow, Standard (Pack of 1), White
features: PERFECT CHILL TECHNOLOGY: Reactive surface-cooling technology is temperature-responsive, adapting to your unique needs for a refreshing night’s sleep.
SealyChill GEL SUPPORT: Soothing gel layer provides a refreshing cool-to-the-touch sensation and increased support. Dimensional design relaxes you and promotes pressure relief.
EASY CARE COVER: Easy-zip stretch-knit cover is easy to remove and machine washable & dryable. fibbers in the cover help protect the pillow against common allergens.
QUALITY: Proudly designed & assembled in the USA and backed by over 130 years of Sealy quality.
STANDARD SIZE PILLOW: At 16” x 24” x 5. 75” this pillow fits a queen size pillowcase.
description: Turn it down a notch. The Sealy Duo Chill Cooling Gel Memory Foam Bed Pillow pairs surface-cooling technology on one side with a refreshing gel layer on the other side for a double dose of cooling relief. The Perfect Chill surface-cooling technology is temperature-responsive, adapting to your unique needs for soothing comfort. Flip to the SealyChill gel side for a cool-to-the-touch sensation and increased support. These cooling capabilities are enhanced with the included stretch-knit cover – built soft and breathable for better airflow. The moisture-wicking fabric adds to the cooling experience by keeping you cool and dry. The cover is also equipped with properties, helping your pillow stay fresh. Simply unzip to remove the cover and machine wash for easy care.
